verdict.rationale: The evidence shows managed OAuth for end users, per-user account connections via external_user_id/accountId, and separation of development and production environments. None of it documents issuing scoped or least-privilege API credentials for an agent. Per-user account binding and environment isolation are adjacent controls, not permission-scoped credential issuance, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
